note: Académie française gives the ordinary senses words/remarks exchanged in conversation and the subject or matter being discussed; these are more central than the current narrow gloss.
The current definition consists only of obscure specialist senses and omits the basic meaning entirely. Jeu means game/play and also set, hand, play/movement in context.
Feu is the noun fire, but as an adjective before a noun it can also mean late/deceased ('feu mon père'). Adjective POS is listed but its meaning is missing.
proposed_english: fire; late/deceased (literary/formal adjective before a noun)

note: Confiance means both confidence and trust; omitting 'trust' is a major learner gap.
Reste is the noun remainder/rest, but the same written form also means 'remains/stays' and 'stay!' from rester. The current entry mentions an imperative without verb POS or gloss.
proposed_english: remainder; rest; remains/stays; stay! (form of rester)
proposed_pos: noun / finite verb form / imperative form

note: Agir centrally means act/take action/behave. 'Prosecute/sue' requires the construction agir en justice and should not lead the gloss.
proposed_english: to act; to take action; to behave; to sue/take legal action (agir en justice)

note: Plan is not only a noun; as an adjective it means flat/level. Since adjective POS is listed, that meaning should be included.
The current entry omits the core meanings of monter: go up/climb/rise/increase/assemble. Editing and horse-riding are only secondary uses.
proposed_english: to go up; to climb; to rise; to increase; to assemble/set up; to ride/mount; to edit

note: Cher means dear/beloved or expensive, and adverbially dearly/at a high price. 'Super' is not a normal basic gloss.
proposed_english: dear; beloved; expensive; dearly; at a high price

note: Very common il vaut mieux / equivalence senses omitted.
proposed_english: to be worth; to be equivalent to; to be preferable/better (il vaut mieux)

note: Fête means party/celebration/holiday/feast/name day. It is not itself the ordinary word for birthday (anniversaire).
proposed_english: party; celebration; holiday; feast; name day
